title: Home Hero

fields.name: home_hero_heading
fields.label: Headline
fields.instructions: Each new line becomes a line break in the headline.

fields.name: home_hero_primary_cta
fields.label: Primary CTA button
fields.instructions: Set the button text, destination and whether to open in a new tab. Clear the link to hide this button.

fields.name: home_hero_secondary_cta
fields.label: Secondary CTA button
fields.instructions: Clear the link to hide this button.

fields.name: home_hero_image
fields.label: Hero image
fields.instructions: Choose a large landscape image. If empty, the original cake photo is used.

fields.name: home_hero_image_alt
fields.label: Hero image alternative text
fields.instructions: Describe the image for screen readers. If empty, the Media Library alternative text is used.

fields.name: home_hero_badge
fields.label: Round badge text
fields.instructions: Each new line becomes a line break. Clear to hide the badge.

description: Edit the hero at the top of the Home page.
